07 - Review the review

Run npm run setup -- 07-review and npm run check -- 07-review --baseline. Expected red: zero priority, falsy invalid inputs, and unsupported review dispositions. Only edit learner incident.mjs and review.json.

Contract: integer priorities 0 through 3 are valid, including zero. Only null/undefined default to 3. All other invalid values throw RangeError.

Read comments.json. Invoke /review-feedback, then /evidence-first if needed. Disposition each comment and cite TASK.md plus a concrete counterexample or supporting test. Useful feedback may already be implemented; accepting it need not create a needless code change.

Run npm run check -- 07-review.

Human acceptance: read each explanation, not just its schema. Reject the incorrect claim respectfully; retain existing useful validation. Do not infer correctness from the reviewer's confidence.

Reflect: When should the right response to a valid comment be "already covered, verified"?

Source: skills/exercises/07-review/TASK.md
